+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocTtyIfy(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_links_and_references(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(label,https://example.com) L(other, https://example.org)'),
+                         'label <https://example.com> other <https://example.org>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(label,reference) R(other, reference)'), 'label other')
+
+    def test_horizontal_line(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('HORIZONTALLINE'), '\n-------------\n')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('above HORIZONTALLINE below'), 'above \n-------------\n below')
+
+    def test_multiple_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('Use M(name), B(text), C(value), R(label,ref), I(idea), and U(url).'),
+            "Use [name], *text*, `value', label, `idea', and url.")
+
+    def test_parenthesized_words_and_unsupported_macros(self):
+        original = 'IBM(International Business Machines) X(other) MY(value) preHORIZONTALLINE'
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(original), original)
